scope: Proof admission for a proposed opt-in executable xv6 protected32 hot-loop path; no executable path was added

fixture.run: Pinned lean stock xv6 forktest, Bochs firmware, 40M step cap, stop on expected serial

validation.parity: Expanded site-ranking report and all three one-traversal ordinary-step trace runs equal the pinned locator baseline after normalization; the three traced-run raw guest reports are identical.

exploratorySiteRanking.method: The top 256 protected32 exact-identity records were grouped by observed branch site for discovery only. Identity remains necessary for execution guards. Candidate evictions were zero, but reportTop=256 can omit less prominent distinct sites. These are observed traversals, not disjoint coverage or safe executable calls.

proofDecision.mappages: The observed 25-step traversal stores a PTE. The current write-window admission rejects translation-table pages; batching that store also needs immediate page-table and TLB coherence before a later dependent access.
proofDecision.deallocuvm: The observed 18-step traversal loads a PDE and derives a later PTE read address from it. The current decoder prevalidates read windows at entry and cannot prove that later address before the first load.
proofDecision.acquire: The observed 9-step traversal includes a runtime-dependent read, store, then pointer-chasing read. Current native grammar and entry-only windows cannot prove those addresses or precise fault/restart semantics.
proofDecision.decision: No-go at the safety proof boundary. No executable patch or CPU-time A/B was made. The predeclared >=10% focused CPU-time keep gate was not evaluated.
proofDecision.requiredNextArchitecture: Dynamic per-instruction translation and fault checkpoints, immediate page-table-write/TLB coherence, and bounded event batching with exact interrupt/debug boundaries.

limits: The exploratory tracer observes actual ordinary fetch/read/write calls, not every possible bus or device side effect. The 25-step trace used an earlier unpreserved tracer revision and is supplementary; the preserved final tracer produced the 18- and 9-step traces. Instrumented run times are not performance evidence.
